postflow.name: PostFlow
postflow.title: PostFlow
postflow.problem: Posting manually to all social platforms takes time, causes burnout, and leads to inconsistent branding.
postflow.solution: PostFlow helps you schedule your content, automate your posting across platforms like Facebook and LinkedIn, and stay visible without lifting a finger.
steps: Fill in your content sheet with posts, images, and timing.
Connect your platforms and set your posting times.
Let PostFlow publish for you — on time, every time.

features.title: Multi-Platform Support
features.desc: Publish to Facebook, LinkedIn, and more with a single setup.

features.title: Visual Scheduling
features.desc: Stay in control of your calendar and adjust posts with ease.

features.title: Image & Video Friendly
features.desc: Easily attach visuals to make your posts stand out.

appointflow.name: AppointFlow
appointflow.title: AppointFlow
appointflow.tagline: Appointments that book — and remind — themselves.
appointflow.problem: Clinics and service providers often lose clients due to missed or forgotten appointments.
appointflow.solution: AppointFlow lets you schedule client appointments and sends automatic reminders 24 hours before the session, reducing no-shows and improving efficiency.
steps: Clients book their appointments through your system.
AppointFlow tracks the time and contact details.
24 hours before the session, the client gets a reminder via email or SMS.

features.title: Automated Reminders
features.desc: No need to call manually — the system does it for you.

features.title: Client-Friendly Experience
features.desc: Reminders sent in clear, polite formats via multiple channels.

features.title: Easy Setup for Clinics & Freelancers
features.desc: Perfect for dental clinics, therapists, salons, and more.

leadflow.name: LeadFlow
leadflow.title: LeadFlow
leadflow.problem: Business owners often miss opportunities because they don’t know when a potential client shows interest.
leadflow.solution: LeadFlow captures inquiries from your forms and immediately notifies you or your team — so no lead goes unanswered.
steps: A client submits a form or expresses interest.
LeadFlow collects and organizes their data.
You get an instant alert via email or WhatsApp so you can respond fast.

features.title: Real-Time Notifications
features.desc: Never miss a hot lead again — respond while they’re still thinking about you.

features.title: Flexible Channel Delivery
features.desc: Receive alerts via email, WhatsApp, or integrate with your CRM.

features.title: Simple Setup
features.desc: Works with your existing contact forms or landing pages.

contactflow.name: ContactFlow
contactflow.title: ContactFlow (Service)
contactflow.tagline: Google Maps scraping as a service.
contactflow.problem: Manually collecting business contact data from Google Maps is time-consuming, error-prone, and unscalable.
contactflow.solution: ContactFlow is a service that gathers relevant business data (name, phone, website, category, etc.) directly from Google Maps and delivers it neatly into a Google Sheet — filtered by your needs.
steps: You send us your target keywords or industries.
We run a Google Maps scan using automated tools.
You receive a cleaned, structured sheet with contact info ready to use.

features.title: Human-Filtered Results
features.desc: We clean and validate the data before delivering.

features.title: Customizable Filters
features.desc: Target cities, industries, or specific keywords.

features.title: Delivered in Google Sheets
features.desc: Easy to review, import, and connect to your lead system.
